scope: Pinned historical raster/source diagnostics only; three route states and two isolated arrival-feed sections per image.

checks.historicalImagePins: 6/6 verified against recording anchors or capture-manifest hashes
checks.appearanceReproduction: 6/6 source/local appearance records exactly reproduced with pinned classifier snapshot
checks.sourceExcerptHashes: 5/5 retained excerpt hashes verify; original bundles were not fetched or reverified
checks.repeatability: 11/11 diagnostic raster/plot/JSON outputs reproduce byte-for-byte through verify.mjs

findings.finding: Broad cyan hue support admits all four interior corner samples in both source/local clearance and arrival ROIs (16/16). Historical clearance glow counts 1542909/1443939 and arrival 351669/305376 therefore do not isolate route halos.
findings.limit: These corner samples are contamination diagnostics; they are not a reviewed route-background mask. No global support gate changed.

findings.finding: At both isolated arrival-feed sections (x=24,80 raster), the source independently detected bright peak is RGB [225,245,252] at y=738 and fails the strict source cyan predicate. Local peak [247,255,255] starts at y=751 and passes its different near-white cyan predicate. Current selected-color supports cannot be equated with the same bright core quantity.
findings.limit: The local white plateau spans several equally bright pixels; first-maximum peak y is not its centerline. This cannot qualify centerline or geometry.

findings.finding: Independent mean-RGB and cyan-residual profiles show a bright central peak plus broad cyan shoulders in the source, and an abrupt local luminous band. Mean-RGB half-height spans are 12 CSS px source and 24 CSS px local at both sections. At 80% peak they are 8.5 and 11.5 CSS px; at 90% source is 5/6 and local 11.5 CSS px.
findings.limit: Peak-fraction widths measure composited encoded-sRGB intensity. They are not calibrated physical-core thickness and are not geometry failure assertions.

findings.finding: Per-image background sidebands bound source RGB residual noise to 1/2 digital levels and local to zero. Source total residual-envelope spans change from 83/84 CSS px at threshold 3 to 60/60.5 at 5 and 41 at 10; local spans are 25.5,25.5,25. Width endpoints close within both independently evaluated strips.
findings.limit: Thresholds 3/5/10 are sensitivity probes, not accepted visibility or edge-error thresholds. Source graded falloff has no unique raster halo boundary. Two nearby sections demonstrate local repeatability, not full-route coverage.

findings.finding: Pinned retained renderer excerpt defines a bloom postprocess; retained source-confirmed route records define red radius 0.075 and blue 0.125. Pinned current local code defines depth-tested normal-blended core tubes and an additive larger blue tube (radius scale 2.15, opacity 0.2). Authored physical radii and composited visible halo profiles are distinct quantities.
findings.limit: Excerpt integrity verifies retained text only, not fresh source bundle correspondence. Current local snapshots are not recaptured or rebound to the historical rendered packet. No component-only raster layer or bloom decomposition is available.

findings.finding: Activation-route helper reproduces source/local core counts 35732/36999 and outside-core hue counts 4716/2238, with its original qualified band labels. These are red-color support counts, not independently calibrated halo profiles.
findings.limit: No whole red feeder geometry, mask, or renderer layer was borrowed or newly qualified. Branch/contact and material-edge semantics still need independent challenges.

supports: A small inactive cross-section helper can recover bright peaks and surrounding graded residuals independently on each raster without source-mask borrowing.
The saved cyan predicate omits the source white peak, and its broad hue halo predicate admits background; reproductions and raw RGB profiles make this directly reviewable.
Core/halo work should measure apparent bright-profile and falloff quantities separately from source-confirmed tube radius.
blockers: No accepted same-quantity core definition or calibrated core-edge error envelope across source bloom and local additive surfaces.
No accepted halo visibility threshold; source residual falloff spans vary by 42-43 CSS px across the tested thresholds.
No full-route independently reviewed negative/background, branch/contact, clipping and pulse contamination validation.
Historical images cannot establish current acquisition provenance, source/local timing equivalence, current comparison qualification or personal visual acceptance.

smallestProposedImplementation.change: Add an inactive independent cross-section diagnostic helper that returns raw RGB samples, per-image remote background fit/noise, bright-profile widths at declared fractions, and threshold-sensitivity envelopes. Keep halo status blocked until threshold/error/negative validation exists. Keep existing ROI, minimum support and historical color classifiers intact; do not infer geometry radius or activate in comparison.
acceptanceChallenges: white core survives without saturated hue
cyan-tinted blank background returns no beam
clipped or contaminated sidebands block fit
graded halos retain explicit threshold uncertainty
changed source/local intensity cannot be relabeled identical core support

stopCondition: Evidence checkpoint complete. No shared implementation, capture, browser, build, network, source/test/docs edit or geometry/surface change performed.
